brief:
A majority of Americans oppose military action against Iran, according to Middle East Eye, as opposition to Israel's conduct in Gaza hardens two years into the conflict. House Democrats are moving to reduce military aid to Israel, signaling fractures in congressional support that once stood largely unified.

The shifts reflect changing political terrain both among voters and elected officials. Pro-Israel advocacy groups, including AIPAC, face mounting pressure as Democratic lawmakers increasingly distance themselves from unconditional support for Israeli military operations.

title: American public opinion shifts against Israel's Gaza war
